Pre-release review · v0.2.0Native macOS · English & Korean

Nariz Flow Working title · 나리즈 플로우

Find an earlier copy, make it ready, and return to your work. Nariz Flow keeps text and image history close, with a shortcut you choose and a compact window you can customise.

Crop or mark an image before pasting, clean up text, and insert a selected item with double-click or Enter after granting direct-paste permission. Original history items remain intact. Eight built-in Mac guides and favourite actions help with common tasks.

  • On your Mac: clipboard content is encrypted locally; no in-app account, ads, analytics SDKs or clipboard uploads.
  • Focus: clipboard history, quick image editing, text cleanup and simple Mac guidance. Automatic translation, OCR and cloud sync are not included.
  • Status: not published on the Mac App Store. Final distribution signing, additional hardware and accessibility checks remain release gates.

Playable demo · v0.15PC · macOS / WindowsGodot 4

OXY DEEP

The world has flooded, and the last people live on the mountaintops. You dive down the drowned slopes to find what was left behind. Oxygen is your health and your clock.

The core mechanic is the purification line: hold a button, draw a loop through the water, and close it to clear the water inside, which leaves a pocket of real air you can breathe and walk on. Each pocket becomes the starting point for the next one.

  • Stage 1 demo: rescue story with one companion, three equipment rewards, a boss and an exit sequence
  • Testing: automated route and regression suites run against the native build
  • Target: Steam release (store page not yet live)
Pre-release review · v0.6.14Android · Older adults

Heungeul Trot 흥얼트로트

A familiar melody, a favourite singer, your own collection. Heungeul Trot helps older adults in Korea browse public YouTube performances by singer or era, search with text or voice, and save favourite performances into personal playlists.

A guided first run helps people choose text size, brightness and favourite singers. Recent performances from selected singers, one-tap heart playback, an unobtrusive quick menu and fixed primary actions keep everyday tasks within reach. Song requests and support can be typed or dictated, with replies viewed in the app; no name or phone-number field is required.

Humming and original-recording recognition are integrated with a public backend, but real-world recognition accuracy is still being validated. Lyrics search is excluded from this release. AdMob placements are limited to a home-feed banner, occasional catalog cards and optional rewarded points; release verification is in progress.

  • Catalog: 3,000+ public YouTube performances, updated through a companion admin. This is a performance count, not a guarantee of every singer's complete discography.
  • Privacy: playlists and favourite singers stay on the phone. Audio is sent to the recognition provider only after consent; the app server does not retain recordings.
  • Status: final pre-release review; not published on Google Play. Real-device recognition, production rewards and store review remain release gates.

Early development · v0.1Android · Accessibility

AnsimLens

AnsimLens starts with a practical problem: small text on a phone screen. The current Android build offers screen magnification through an accessibility service and zooming for user-selected photos.

Reading aloud, plain-language explanations and user-initiated family help requests are planned, not implemented. The intended explanation workflow keeps the source text visible and avoids claims it cannot support. Protected screens are not bypassed.

  • Now: screen magnifier, photo zoom
  • Next: read-aloud, plain explanations, family help requests

The existing Studio Nariz business

A photography studio in Jamsil.

Studio Nariz operates a body-profile photography studio in Songpa-gu, Seoul. The photography business and the software projects on this page share the same registered business, established in August 2024.

Shoots are organised around concepts such as bath, bedroom, stonewall and black. One-to-one posing direction helps clients prepare for the session; the studio provides the full set of high-resolution originals and selected retouched images.

How we build

We use native platforms, practical prototypes and project-specific testing to develop PC, Android and Mac software.

Development assistance

Claude and Codex assist development. The projects use Godot with GDScript, native Android with Kotlin, and Swift for macOS.

Project-level verification

The development records include gameplay route tests, Android unit and emulator checks, and native Mac clipboard and image-editing tests. Hardware coverage and final store review remain product-specific release gates.

Clear limits

Implemented features are separated from planned ones. AnsimLens will not promise access to protected screens or treat an unsupported explanation as a fact.
